summary: Repaired all three lean-challenge-snapshot.sh defects across 6 phases in the source store (~/.config/nvim): committed the already-landed Goals list-item anchor and keyword-denylist repair; replaced four ASCII-only identifier literals with one shared Unicode-aware pattern; widened the declaration-chunk boundary to recognize abbrev and anonymous instance while decoupling boundary detection from name harvesting and body forcing; narrowed Goals-identifier extraction to each bullet's own leading identifier run; and added an opt-in --dry-run --compile step with a new fatal exit code. The suite grew from 17 to 29 passing cases. The deployed .claude/** tree was regenerated (RESULT=landed_verify_clean) and verified byte-identical to the source store, with the deployed suite green including the previously-failing R8 case.
